limitations.note: The arithmetic rewrite corrected the two wrong coin credits but also replaced the original FSM’s level-sensitive inputs and combinational payouts with edge detection, registered payouts, and a change queue.
The rewrite kept the ports but removed the original public state parameters, so an instantiation that overrides those parameters would no longer compile.
The testbench assumed the rewrite’s rising-edge coin detection and queued payouts, so even 377,700 passing cycles could not establish that the fix preserved the original FSM’s behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire test invocation to be rejected before simulation, forcing the agent to recreate the test invocation with a different temporary-directory wrapper.
